title: MapMyFitness Heart-Rate Drift on Repeat Route
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mapmyfitness:activity route_id=*
stats avg(avg_hr_bpm) as hr by route_id _time
streamstats window=3 avg(hr) as baseline by route_id
where hr>baseline*1.08
description: Compares MapMyFitness heart rate on the same route to catch cardiac drift or fatigue.
value: Surfacing mapmyfitness heart-rate drift on repeat route helps you act before small issues become habits.
implementation: Ingest the relevant fitness & activity tracking export into `index=personal` and schedule this search weekly.
visualization: Table or chart of key fields.
grandmaExplanation: It gives you when mapmyfitness heart-rate drift on repeat route matters for your routine.
